scientific_summary: For n training observations and one exchangeable future observation, the externally studentized prediction residual has exact sharp one-sided tail bounds given by a finite-sample Cantelli staircase; the resulting p-box needs no moments, bounded support, or range correction.
limitations: Sharpness is over exchangeable laws, not asserted for the iid subclass; the theorem is unconditional rather than conditional on realized sample summaries; older inaccessible prediction-interval sources remain a residual originality risk.
